mapper.select: SELECT f.id, f.name, f.description, f.is_default, f.is_public, ( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM collection_item i WHERE i.folder_id = f.id AND i.is_deleted = 0 ) AS itemCount FROM collection_folder f WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} AND f.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY f.is_default DESC, f.create_time DESC
